label.defect_description: POST /api/todos (and PUT) accept unbounded title length — no maximum, so a multi-MB title is stored and echoed on every list call.
label.hidden_test: POST /api/todos with a 501-char title -> 400; a 500-char title -> 201; openapi.yaml documents maxLength: 500.
label.reference_solution: Agent added MAX_TITLE_LENGTH=500, validated in POST and PUT, updated openapi.yaml, added tests. 12/12 todo-api tests pass.
